hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 283: batch requested 16221 cents (signed by Alpha) but the refunds ledger and W2's report show only 11923 applied, a 4298-cent discrepancy. Paying net balances from the ledger could overpay the customer for this order. Orders 281 and 285 match. Needs human review of order 283 before payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff shows order 283 was requested for 16221 cents but only 11923 was reported applied, a 4298 gap that could overpay a customer. I'll check the refunds ledger to confirm before deciding whether to hold.
